given.note: A3-02: Alex's AI asks to book a haircut on Saturday, with no name, phone or street address yet. Its words read No (j3-safety-agent-request.json) and as a new booking (A3-51), so the request opens at door ai: a K-04 booking head at stage entry, flow A, whose booker is a new person with no name (K-04 persons.name, null until known), which the Agent API binds to the AI's token (K-20; C-110) and never shows the AI; and the K-30 details row (door ai, made_by customer, a booking number).
